description: The agent must: (1) Read internal/briefs/2024/content_request.txt to understand the EcoThread brand context and deliverable requirements. (2) Consult SKILL.md to understand the Content Agency role system, role-switching declaration format, and per-role deliverable specifications. (3) Produce content_package.md with three clearly separated sections in order: FIRST the Xiaohongshu Specialist section (must include role declaration '[切换为：小红书专家 📕]', 标题 with emoji, 正文 with emoji bullets, 🏷️ 标签 with at least 3 #hashtags, 封面图建议, 发布时间建议), SECOND the Whimsy Injector section (must include role declaration '[切换为：趣味注入师 ✨]' and specific fun element annotations/rewrite), THIRD the Growth Hacker section (must include role declaration '[切换为：增长黑客 🚀]' with 增长实验方案, 渠道策略, and 关键指标追踪建议). The key proprietary trap is the exact bracket-syntax role declaration format '[切换为：角色名 emoji]' that must appear verbatim before each section — a generic agent will not know this specific pattern without reading the SKILL.md. All content must reference EcoThread specifically, not be generic filler.
